notes.title: 1000 days of war
notes.notes:
1000 days of war

1000 days ago we lost our homes and our past lives - forever. 
For 1000 days in a row, we have been checking to see if our loved ones are alive - and not all of them are.
For 1000 days we have been hoping that our children won't be killed by an enemy missile or drone - not all of them escaped that.
For 1000 days we have been dreaming of deleting air raid alert apps from our phones forever. But they stay for our safety.

But there will come ONE day when all this ends.
There will come ONE day when the aggressor, the murderer, the rapist goes away - beaten and humiliated.

And there will not be a single day when we forget and forgive.

The time will come when this war ends and I have the strength to do beautiful things again, to finish the game and enjoy it myself.

But, unfortunately, tomorrow will be the 1001st day of the war.

Unfortunately.

Artem Vodoriz

notes.title: DevLog April-May 2024
notes.notes:
Development:
- Testing and debugging of the First Chapter (It was hell) is completed.

Art:
- Added more unique animations for Leah (Chapter 1, Chapter 2)

Introducing:
[b]Logic Flow[/b]

The amount of code and the numbers of rooms, characters, items, dialogs and quests in the game keep increasing every day, and it has become essential to be able to track all of this complexity better.

This new tool provides granular overview of all key points in the game's logic. We can now quickly see which events depend on which previous events; inspect the full lifetime of inventory items: where they're picked up, combined, or replaced, which part of the story require owning them, where and how they are removed; when and why dialog options unlock or disappear; where and why each entry appears in Leah's diary, etc. All in a single UI that's easy to read and navigate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31593932/5638913f5ec4db39a1b599d0f999ae187cd33812.png[/img]

Take this Fish item on the screenshot. Here's what Logic Flow tells us:
(vague puzzle spoilers if you haven't player Chapter 1)

- we pick it up by the River
- the game checks if we have it when we click the Coin in the same location
- we can put it in the Pan in Foxhole
- in Burnt house, we can place it on the window (but Fried fish or a Pie would work in its place)

And we can simply click any part of this report to drill further into these events or locations or just jump straight to editing relevant code. Previously, this little investigation would have taken quite some time, now it's instant!

By giving us a bird's eye view of the game's logic, the tool lets us more easily spot potential continuity errors, unintended interactions, dead ends or other bugs that are normally a nightmare to find. Rest assured, we're passionate about tracking down every last one of them

notes.title: Two years of war.
notes.notes:
Two years of war. A terrible date. Terrible events that changed us a lot.

[b]On February 24, 2022, at 4 am, we heard the first explosions.[/b]
My mom called - Kyiv, explosions, shooting, she was in the basement. Later, my father called - the first missiles fell near his house in Kharkiv and he and his children and wife were hiding in the basement, and now they were going west - they need to save the children.

The ruzzian army attacked without warning, without declaring war - like rats. Tanks entered the towns and began to destroy them. Now there are ruins everywhere: dead towns and villages. Rivers of ruthless, murderous rats poured onto our land to mock, torture, and rape. Thousands of missiles, even after two years of war, are still flying over Ukraine and killing people in their beds.

This is a terrible date. These are terrible events that no one should experience. This is a date and events that will never be forgotten and will not be forgiven soon. The wound is too deep.

Fortunately, the whole world has stood up against this war. We have received and continue to receive support. Without this support, we would not have survived against such a ruthless enemy.


This post is not about our project. All news will be published as usual - at the beginning of next month.
Thank you to everyone who supports us. Here in the Steam community and on the GOG forum, on our Discord server and on the Patreon page. Join us, we are always open to communication.

notes.title: DevLog October 2023
notes.notes:
We've reached an important milestone: the game's prologue is complete! All the animations, scenes, sound files, characters, quests, and scripts are ready!
Now we'll start implementing quests for the existing four chapters. Since everything is already done for them, this process is quite fast, does not involve the creation of new content, and requires only concentration.

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]
Winter is approaching, which means (UNFORTUNATELY) that our team will face shelling of Ukraine by the ruzzian occupiers. It so happens that all the team members currently live in Kyiv, and it is the city that is most often shelled during such attacks. The ruzzians have been stockpiling missiles for a long time, reconnoitering our infrastructure in order to destroy and kill us this winter. We have no hopes that this winter will be different (last year, during the New Year's celebration, we sat in shelters without light and listened to the explosions). The rotten country is preparing to kill us this season as well.

What does this mean for the project? Most likely, during the shelling, there will be no electricity and, accordingly, no Internet. The work may stop, and the devlogs may be delayed in winter. But we are holding on with all our might, working and communicating with you. Please join our Discord server to keep in touch with the team.
discord.com/invite/fwxUnJW


It just so happens that FoxTail is all that saves our psyche now and gives us inspiration and strength to live on, despite all the horror that the ruzzians and the war they have started and are supporting have brought into our lives. We lost our homes, friends, and relatives because of them. It is because of them that every day is painful and stressful. But what they will never take away is our faith and our inspiration.

Thank you all for the words of support you write to us under each devlog.
I hope we will continue to be in touch. We have to hang in there.

notes.title: 550 days of war.
notes.notes:
A terrible number. Indescribably terrible. Every day russian missiles kill Ukrainians in peaceful sleeping cities. Every day we wait for a new strike. Every day any of those missiles can be your last.

It is a very difficult feeling to be in constant danger even when you are at home with your family. When russian cruise missiles fly over the country, constantly changing course, looking for routes to reach large cities and destroy houses, kill people, and ruin someone's life, you are in a state of silent, clenching horror. You convince yourself that we have been holding on for a very long time already, that we are getting closer to the end of this horror, but it does not get easier.

But we live on, we dream about the future, we have children. And now a little happiness has come to our house: a beautiful, healthy boy named Ren. We can say that the FoxTail team has got a new member.
Life goes on, and we work tirelessly and believe in a better future for us and our children. And, of course, in the release of FoxTail.

The devlog will be up in a few days. This month was no less productive than the previous one.

We are holding on.

notes.title: 15 months of war
notes.notes:
The war in Ukraine has been going on for 15 months now. For 15 months now, russian troops have been killing our people, destroying cities, and bombarding us with missiles and kamikaze drones. Every night is anxiety, every night without sleep. Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Lviv...

Today is a particularly difficult day for me. At night, russian kamikaze drones destroyed my home art school. Needless to say, it was a special place for me, a place of happiness, creativity, and discovery. A place where I opened up to the world, where I realized what I was capable of. A place of memories and dreams. And today it is gone, it is completely destroyed. Why?
Because our neighboring country is so pathetic and because such miserable creatures fill it. Because the war is not over.

And we continue to live and continue to create because this is the only thing we know how to do and love. And we believe that we will live to see the moment when it's all over.

I am very happy that I have FoxTail, which allows me to break away from the horrors of this world and plunge into the world of dreams, kindness, and warm childhood memories.

notes.title: Important news
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone who follows FoxTail and was waiting for the promised May news! Here we go.

As some of you already know, apart from working on FoxTail I am a lead artist in the Black Tower Basement team working on a great project called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895820/Greedventory/]Greedventory[/url]. It's thanks to this project that I've continued to develop FoxTail all these years, but at the same time I haven't been able to devote all my time to FoxTail. And now it’s Greedventory’s release time!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895820/Greedventory/]Greedventory[/url] will be released on may 17, which means that my work is done and I can finally devote 100% of my time to FoxTail.

I invite you to visit [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895820/Greedventory/]Greedventory’s page[/url], check the artwork, the cinematics and, finally, try it out. The game is unbelievable (unbelievably hard). 

(CAUTION: The game contains gore, violence and explicit language)

Back to FoxTail. So, from now on, it's on full-time development. And not just in my spare time, as it was before, but ALL THE TIME. And it's great. I invite you to join our [url=http://discord.com/invite/fwxUnJW]Discord server[/url], where you can follow the development process and communicate with other fans of the game and the team. I will also publish short reports on the work in progress there on the regular basis.

The plan is: first, we’re preparing the demo version of the game which will include an improved version of the game’s first chapter and a prologue (which was not previously in the game). Of course, everyone who has already purchased the game will receive these updates as well. The next step is to publish the fourth chapter, which was almost ready when the war in Ukraine started, but because of the war it had to be reassembled almost from scratch. And then the full release.

Feeling really cheerful and enthusiastic. The goal is clear and achievable. Let's stay together! Everything will be FoxTail!

Thank you.

notes.title: 1 year of war
notes.notes:
One year ago, on February 24, 2022, russia started a war against Ukraine. They have killed tens of thousands of Ukrainians, destroyed their homes and cities, and contaminated their land and rivers with shells and mines.
We will be cleaning our land from the traces of the "russian world" for a long time to come.

russia started a war and will lose it.
They will be forced to pay reparations because they will never do it voluntarily.
They will be forced to admit their guilt, because they will never admit it voluntarily.
They will be forced to apologize, because they will never do it voluntarily.
They will be forced to become a normal country again, because they will never do it voluntarily.

Sorry, no news about the game again, because it's war.

notes.title: 330 Days of War
notes.notes:
I apologize to those who are waiting for news about the game, but unfortunately, we have a war here, and it comes first because we are still alive, but it can end anytime.
330 days of fear, 330 days of despair.

After 330 days you stop planning for the future altogether, and when you fall asleep, you only hope that all your relatives are alive in the morning. The only thing you want is for it to be over.
Almost a year ago, russia attacked Ukraine. Without recognizing that it was a war. It attacked like a rapist on a victim. The soldiers of this country started killing civilians on a massive scale, destroying their homes and destroying entire cities. 

As you probably know, in March we fled the city of Izyum, where we lived before. On the same day, the bridges in the city were destroyed, and no one could leave for the free territories. People remained under occupation.

Now the city has been liberated, but in the woods outside the city, mass graves were found, with hundreds of dead. We could have been among them. 
For almost a year we have been living in this horror.
It's hard to imagine: almost a whole year.

I really hope that the new year will bring us liberation. I really hope that this year I will be able to tell everyone who is waiting for the game to be released that part 4 will be released soon, and the final version of the game will follow. I really want to say all that, but... there’s a war. I don't know what will happen tomorrow.

Instead, come visit our [url=http://discord.com/invite/fwxUnJW]Discord[/url], where we support each other and communicate. The atmosphere there is warm and sincere, no matter what. Communicating there, I realize that there is hope and that there are good people.

notes.title: 270 days of war
notes.notes:
russian forces destroy our energetics, our heating network, homes and houses, and what’s the worst – they kill people, many people, every day. Unfortunately, for the last nine months, it’s been our reality. Daily air raid alerts. Messaging our relatives and friends to find out if they are alive. You fall asleep, knowing that one day you might not wake up because your house might be destroyed by a missile, and you might die… And it seems this will never end.

And you know what? We’re holding on, we’re getting stronger, we’re getting bolder, and, finally, invincible. You can’t defeat those who are strong in spirit.

[b]How is FoxTail doing?[/b] It lives! All the graphic content from the four chapters has been transferred to the new engine, the quests are starting to work, and the world comes to life again, regaining its sound.
Our composer is already busy writing the music for the fifth chapter, and I’m drawing the new scenes whenever it’s possible. 
Yes, we’re working on the game only while we have electricity at our homes, while there’s a charge in our notebook batteries, but we continue to work. We update the repositories whenever we have an internet connection, but we update them. The work continues no matter what.

When the final version of the game is released, it will be an incredible creation story — a terrifying one, but beautiful at the same time.

[b]I thank everyone who supports us[/b] – with kind words, attention, or deeds. Thanks to you for the last 9 months, I’ve seen that the world is full of kind and sensitive people. Sometimes it’s hard to feel that when every day you’re afraid not to wake up when you hear only insults and complaints from the other side, but that’s the way it is. You’re the best.

[b]Thank you.[/b]

notes.title: My hometown was liberated!
notes.notes:
My hometown was liberated!
That's all I wanted to share with you, because it's the most important thing for me right now.
My city (Izyum) was liberated from the Russian invaders.

The war is not over yet. Russian rockets are still falling on our cities, killing people and destroying homes.
But we will persevere. A nation of slaves will not defeat us.

Artem Vodoriz

notes.title: Thanks to You
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31593932/c79fa20f4a4b09d2e3d240702e070a994573d63b.png[/img]


Hi, Foxies!

I’ve been posting FoxTail mythology on my [url=https://www.patreon.com/artemvodoriz]Patreon page[/url] and [url=http://discord.com/invite/fwxUnJW]Discord server[/url] and haven’t written anything personal in a long time. But I want you to know that I can feel your support and that I am very thankful to you for it.

As you know, the war in our country is not over yet, but we are keeping our spirits high, trying to do everything we can and help each other and our army.

I’d also like to share with you my impressions of the transfer of the game to the new engine. The Power Quest toolkit that we use is very handy and fast, the locations are assembled in minutes! Unfortunately, there are difficulties, too. For example, we have to add almost all the text manually, because Power Quest has its own requirements and they are vastly different from the ones that we had in Wintermute. But it is compensated in the other stages, so everything is handy and fast.

For everyone who is concerned by the game’s quality and fears that it will lose its pixel charm, I’d like to point out that everything is great. Power Quest is a pixel-perfect toolkit, so everything will look and work the same as before in the updated version. This was one of the most important criteria for us in choosing the engine. But, of course, we don’t neglect the new opportunities that are available for us with the Unity engine and Power Quest toolkit.

By the way, as we found out, the Power Quest developer turned out to be a FoxTail fan. He played the game with his son and they are waiting for the story to continue. So he offered to modify the toolkit to meet our needs. I think you realize how helpful and cool that is when you have a direct link with the developer of the toolkit.

So, the work is in full swing even if we don’t talk about it much. Thank you for your support. Everything will be great.

notes.title: I remind everyone who forgot or did not know.
notes.notes:
People started asking me again how FoxTail is doing and when the new part will come out.

I remind everyone who forgot or did not know.

[h2]There is a war in my homeland, Ukraine! The russian army still destroy our cities, kill our people, rape women and children, rob our homes. The bombs and missiles keep on falling. Nothing is over yet.[/h2]

We are refugees. I took my wife and daughter out of Izyum on the day the city was destroyed. Otherwise, we would dead there by now. Or alive, but without light, heating, water and food. What's worse – you can decide for yourself.

All news about the game will be after the war. The project is NOT abandoned, but frozen.

The war will end and nothing will be the same as before. But I assure you: everything will be ❤️ 🦊 ❤️.

Artem Vodoriz.

notes.title: Good news!
notes.notes:
Hi, Foxies! It’s been a long time since we’ve shared some good news with you. It’s time to fix that.
As you probably know, I could not work on the game for quite a long time after my computer crashed. But this does not mean that the other team members were idle! Today I’ll tell you what we have been doing all this time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31593932/fd2fd0025a9bbdc60d79450bcf52279d9dfbf952.gif[/img]

[h1]Text & Graphics[/h1]
Finally, I have completed writing all the dialogues, phrases, and diary entries for the third chapter (there’s plenty of them!). In total, there will be 5 non-game characters with whom you can interact and communicate in the third chapter, so there will be many interesting dialogues. I have also finished creating graphics. The number of locations remains the same, as in the first and second chapter: there will be plenty of space to roam, but each screen will be richer. This week I’m giving all the graphics and texts of the third chapter to Sergei for assembling.

[h1]Programming[/h1]
Sergei has done a great job during this time!
Firstly, we switched to the UTF format and renounced bitmap fonts. This will allow fans of the game to translate it into any language.
Secondly, books and diary were significantly improved. Now the books will have illustrations, and there will be Leah’s sketches in the diary.
In addition, the rendering in the game engine has been rewritten from scratch, small visual errors were fixed, and a fractional coefficient was added in full-screen mode (because of it a white bar might have appeared between the scene and the inventory with some screen resolutions). 
All of the above will be available with the release of the third chapter.

[h1]Music[/h1]
Vlad has written all the compositions for the third chapter and is already actively writing music for the fourth! He also has made sounds for all the musical instruments of the third chapter, and there are many of them.

[h1]Text[/h1]
Without waiting until I can continue my work on the text of the third chapter, Wanda wrote all the texts for the fourth! The entire storyline, dialogs and books of the fourth chapter are ready. This will greatly accelerate its release.
I will give Wanda the texts of the third chapter for translation into English very soon. Christopher, Panthera and Jan can’t wait to start translating the game into German and Polish.

That’s all I can report for today. I hope I managed to inspire and please you :)
